title: Battle of Najafgarh
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Najafgarh", at revision 1370451187, opens: "The Battle of Najafgarh was a subsidiary engagement of the Siege of Delhi during the Indian Rebellion of 1857. A large Indian force sortied from Delhi, intending to attack the rear of the British force besieging the city. A detachment from the besiegers marched to intercept them, and defeated them while they were disordered by difficult terrain and by quarrels among their commanders." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4087449, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "It was a subsidiary event of the Siege of Delhi during the Indian Rebellion of 1857". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
